$comment: The grammar leg's skip register: parse-kind cases whose rejection lives outside the grammar layer's reach. EMPTY (2026-11-02, the grammar lineage migration): the six executor-dissolution-wave entries (wf-01 step executor, the does/action scoped bodies) and the five earlier reopens are all carried by the per-construct typed surface in grammar/primmel.parg — the routed sub-block dispatch (field/does/action construct routes whose shape trees mirror the generic surface exactly), the only-block-atom value runs with leak assertions, and the TERMINAL sub-keyword-excluded fallbacks (a trailing generic alternative would swallow the routed refusal). The register only shrinks and may only be repopulated with a reason a future case proves; the leg errors on a stale entry, on an entry naming a case that no longer exists, and on a disagreement whose case is not registered.
